Dates.text: Sputnik 1 launches and becomes the first artificial satellite.
Its batteries run out and the radio beeps fall silent.
Sputnik 1 re-enters the atmosphere and burns up.

Title: Sputnik 1, first satellite
Body-Text: On 4 October 1957, the Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1. The world's first artificial satellite was only 58 cm across, weighed 83.6 kg and circled Earth about every 98 minutes. A single launch marked the start of the space age and of the space race between the United States and the USSR.
ModelFacts: Four antennas broadcast its famous beeps
